hooks.command:
node -e "process.stderr.write('
🏗️  Full-Stack Project | Claude Code Workspace
📦 Domains: Frontend · Backend (Go) · Infrastructure · Testing · Product
⚡ Commands: /analyze_codebase /plan_feature /generate_prd /design_architecture /review_code /setup_infra /run_tests

');"

node -e "const cmd = process.env.CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT || ''; const dangerous = ['git push --force', 'git reset --hard', 'rm -rf', 'terraform destroy', 'terraform apply', 'kubectl delete', 'kubectl apply']; const found = dangerous.find(d => cmd.includes(d)); if (found) { process.stderr.write('⚠️  WARNING: Potentially destructive command detected: ' + found + '\nPlease confirm this is intentional.\n'); process.exit(1); }"

CMD=$(python3 -c "import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d.get('tool_input',d).get('command',''))" 2>/dev/null || true); case "$CMD" in *grep*|*rg\ *|*ripgrep*|*find\ *|*fd\ *|*ack\ *|*ag\ *)   [ -f graphify-out/graph.json ] &&   echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","additionalContext":"graphify: knowledge graph at graphify-out/. For focused questions, run `graphify query \"<question>\"` (scoped subgraph, usually much smaller than GRAPH_REPORT.md) instead of grepping raw files. Read GRAPH_REPORT.md only for broad architecture context."}}'   || true ;; esac
